subject: physics

unit.name: System of Particles and Rotational Motion

chapter: System of Particles and Rotational Motion
question_text: If the polar ice caps of the earth were to melt, what would be the effect on the length of the day?

verification.note: Sri Chaitanya IPE Junior Fastrack (Rev. May 2024), Unit 7 VERY SHORT ANSWER. The 1+1 mark split is invented and needs a Telangana IPE teacher; no exam appearance years are printed for this question, so appearances[] stays empty.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What changes
lines: The melted water spreads from the poles
over the whole surface — mass moves
AWAY from the axis, so the earth’s
steps.margin_note: The mark is for "mass moves away from the axis → I increases". Say the mechanism, not just the result.
steps.why: The poles sit ON the rotation axis, where mass contributes almost nothing to I. Spread that mass to the equator and its r — and so mr² — grows.
common_mistakes: Saying the earth becomes heavier. The mass is the same; only its distribution changes.

recall.must_convey: That the melt water spreads outward so the moment of inertia of the earth increases.

steps.memory_tip: One test for every question of this kind: nearer the axis lowers I, farther raises it.

steps.label: The effect
lines: Angular momentum L = Iω is conserved,
so a larger I means a smaller ω.

lines.text: the length of the day INCREASES.

steps.margin_note: Chain the three: I up → ω down → T up. Each arrow is part of the answer.
steps.why: No external torque acts, so the earth pays for its larger I with a slower spin — the same ice-skater physics, run in reverse.
common_mistakes: Concluding the day gets shorter, by forgetting that ω and T are inverses.

recall.must_convey: That with Iω conserved, ω decreases and the day becomes longer.
accept: T equals two pi by omega

steps.memory_tip: T = 2π/ω, so ω down means T up. A 1% slower spin would add about 15 minutes to the day.

insider_note: The direction of the change is the marked answer. Write INCREASES, and give the I-up-ω-down chain that reaches it.
